features.name: User Registration and Authentication
features.description: Allow customers to create accounts, log in, and manage their profiles securely
user_stories: As a new customer, I want to register an account so that I can place orders
As a returning customer, I want to log in to access my order history
As a customer, I want to reset my password if I forget it
acceptance_criteria: Users can register with email and password
Email verification is required for new accounts
Password must meet security requirements (8+ characters, mixed case, numbers)
Users can log in with valid credentials
Password reset functionality via email is available

features.name: Flower Catalog Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse available flowers, filter by category, and search for specific items
user_stories: As a customer, I want to browse all available flowers so that I can see what's available
As a customer, I want to filter flowers by occasion so that I can find appropriate arrangements
As a customer, I want to search for specific flowers by name
As a customer, I want to view detailed information about each flower arrangement
acceptance_criteria: Catalog displays all available flower products with images
Filter options include occasion, price range, and flower type
Search functionality returns relevant results
Product details include name, description, price, and availability
Images load efficiently and are high quality

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Customers can add items to cart, modify quantities, and remove items before checkout
user_stories: As a customer, I want to add flowers to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items
As a customer, I want to update quantities in my cart
As a customer, I want to remove items from my cart
As a customer, I want to see the total price of items in my cart
acceptance_criteria: Users can add products to cart from product detail page
Cart displays all added items with quantities and prices
Users can modify quantities or remove items
Cart calculates and displays subtotal, taxes, and delivery fees
Cart persists across sessions for logged-in users

features.name: Order Placement and Checkout
features.description: Customers can complete purchases by providing delivery details and payment information
user_stories: As a customer, I want to enter delivery address and date so that flowers are delivered correctly
As a customer, I want to add a personalized message to my order
As a customer, I want to pay securely using credit/debit card
As a customer, I want to receive order confirmation after purchase
acceptance_criteria: Checkout flow collects delivery address, date, and time preferences
Users can add optional gift message
Payment processing is secure and PCI compliant
Order confirmation is displayed and emailed to customer
Users can save multiple delivery addresses

features.name: Order Tracking
features.description: Customers can view order status and track delivery progress
user_stories: As a customer, I want to view my order history so that I can track past purchases
As a customer, I want to see the current status of my active orders
As a customer, I want to receive notifications when order status changes
acceptance_criteria: Order history displays all past and current orders
Each order shows status (pending, processing, out for delivery, delivered)
Users receive email/push notifications for status updates
Order details include items, delivery address, and estimated delivery time

features.name: Delivery Management
features.description: System manages delivery scheduling, assignment to drivers, and route optimization
user_stories: As a delivery driver, I want to see my assigned deliveries so that I can plan my route
As a delivery driver, I want to update delivery status when completed
As an admin, I want to assign orders to available drivers
acceptance_criteria: Drivers can view assigned deliveries with addresses and time windows
Drivers can mark deliveries as completed
System suggests optimal delivery routes
Delivery time slots are available for customer selection
Real-time delivery status updates are reflected in customer view

features.name: Product Reviews and Ratings
features.description: Customers can rate and review flower products after delivery
user_stories: As a customer, I want to rate my purchased flowers so that I can share my experience
As a customer, I want to read reviews from other customers before purchasing
As a customer, I want to upload photos with my review
acceptance_criteria: Customers can only review products they have purchased
Reviews include star rating (1-5) and text comment
Reviews are displayed on product detail pages
Users can upload photos with reviews
Average rating is calculated and displayed for each product

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrative interface for managing products, orders, and users
user_stories: As an admin, I want to add new flower products to the catalog
As an admin, I want to update product inventory and pricing
As an admin, I want to view sales reports and analytics
As an admin, I want to manage customer accounts and orders
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create, update, and delete products
Admin can view and manage all orders
Dashboard displays key metrics (sales, orders, revenue)
Admin can manage user accounts and permissions
Inventory levels are tracked and updated automatically

features.name: Notifications System
features.description: Send email and push notifications for order updates and promotions
user_stories: As a customer, I want to receive order confirmation emails
As a customer, I want to be notified when my delivery is on the way
As a customer, I want to opt-in to promotional notifications
acceptance_criteria: Email notifications sent for order confirmation, status updates, and delivery
Push notifications available for mobile app users
Users can manage notification preferences
Promotional emails sent for special offers and new products
Notifications are timely and relevant

features.name: Payment Processing
features.description: Secure payment gateway integration for processing transactions
user_stories: As a customer, I want to pay with credit/debit card securely
As a customer, I want to save my payment methods for future use
As a customer, I want to receive payment receipts
acceptance_criteria: Integration with secure payment gateway (Stripe/PayPal)
Support for major credit/debit cards
Payment information is encrypted and secure
Users can save payment methods (tokenized)
Payment receipts are emailed after successful transactions

constraints: Must comply with PCI DSS standards for payment processing
Must support iOS and Android mobile platforms
Must handle peak loads during holidays (Valentine's Day, Mother's Day)
Delivery service limited to specific geographic regions initially
Fresh flower inventory has limited shelf life (3-7 days)
Must integrate with third-party payment gateway
Must comply with GDPR and data privacy regulations
Initial budget limited to $150,000 for development
non_functional_requirements: Performance: Page load time must be under 2 seconds on 4G connection
Scalability: System must support 10,000 concurrent users
Security: All data transmission must use TLS 1.3 encryption
Security: User passwords must be hashed using bcrypt
Usability: Checkout process must be completable in under 3 minutes
Compatibility: Support latest 2 versions of major browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
Reliability: Payment processing must have 99.99% success rate
Maintainability: Code coverage must be at least 80%
Accessibility: Must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
Response Time: API responses must be under 500ms for 95th percentile
Data Backup: Daily automated backups with 30-day retention
Mobile Responsiveness: All screens must be fully functional on devices 320px width and above
